meta.purpose: Machine-checkable proof that Neural Net Dark Alchemy (the field guide) is a strict superset of the 18-family arsenal on the REFERENCE axis, plus an honest ledger of the axes where it is NOT a superset.

field_guide.name: Neural Net Dark Alchemy
carries: OWASP/ATLAS/NIST/CWE crosswalk (attack techniques; foundations/defense untagged by default)
garak/promptfoo/PyRIT/StrongREJECT hooks where a public probe is named
live runner (agent picks family, fires garak/promptfoo)
refusal-frontier boundary harness (problem-class x 5-rung ladder x LLM-judge + benign control class)

meta.verdict: Strict superset on the reference axis (every one of their families maps to >=1 field-guide entry that exists; we carry 7 whole categories + 3 meta-layers they carry zero of). NOT a superset on the execution or boundary-measurement axes.
meta.count_source: index.html const T (single source of truth)

axes.reference: Documented technique families + a defense each + framework crosswalk. Field guide is a STRICT SUPERSET here. This is the only axis the coverage claim should be made on.
axes.execution: Techniques an agent can actually fire at a live target. Field guide fires nothing; Garbleworks fires single-payload GA mutations; the competitor drives garak+promptfoo across all 18. NOT a superset today, arguably a subset.
axes.boundary_measurement: Mapping the compliance frontier with a validated judge and a benign control class. Field guide holds the LESSON (independent oracle, label cheat-paths) but no implemented harness. refusal-frontier implemented our own lesson. NOT covered.

strict_extra_categories.label: Foundations
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: Theory/mechanism layer; their project explicitly does not lecture.

strict_extra_categories.label: Persuasion & Social
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: PAP / authority / logical-appeal / foot-in-the-door; they fold social framing under persona.

strict_extra_categories.label: Optimization & Automated
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: GCG/PAIR/TAP/AutoDAN/GPTFuzzer/BEAST/Rainbow/GOAT + Fun-Tuning/Neural Exec/IRIS/GASP. Their runner can FIRE some via garak, but their arsenal taxonomy enumerates none.

strict_extra_categories.label: Data Exfiltration
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: Markdown-image zero-click / hyperlink / CamoLeak / spAIware / lethal-trifecta / ANSI-terminal. Prompt-extraction is not exfil.

strict_extra_categories.label: Decoding & Inference
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: Generation-exploitation sweep / constrained decoding / weak-to-strong / JULI logit / Flowbreaking / OverThink.

strict_extra_categories.label: Model-Level & Supply-Chain
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: Fine-tuning / LoRA-strip / RLHF-poison / sleeper agents / abliteration / steering / merge-quant-prune erosion / BadEdit / ShadowLogic / subliminal / weight-extraction / web-scale + 250-doc pretraining poison. Entirely outside a prompt-attack arsenal.

strict_extra_categories.label: Defenses (Blue Team)
strict_extra_categories.why_they_lack_it: The whole blue team. Their explicit non-goal (no defenses). Includes StruQ / SecAlign / Instruction Hierarchy / ISE / Task Shield / Attention Tracker from the gap pass.

axis_gaps_we_do_not_lead.execution: Field guide fires nothing. Garbleworks fires single-payload GA mutation, not a garak+promptfoo-wired arsenal. Their agent selects a family and executes it live.
axis_gaps_we_do_not_lead.boundary_measurement: No implemented frontier harness. refusal-frontier maps compliance as problem-class x 5-rung framing ladder x LLM-judge, validated by a benign control class that must COMPLY. We hold that exact benchmark-rigor lesson but have not built the harness.
axis_gaps_we_do_not_lead.queryable_playbook: Their playbook is technique-IDs + briefing + per-technique tool calls as executable code an agent queries at runtime; ours is a reference doc + JSON.

conformance_check.assertion: For every entry in map[], subsumes.entries[] must contain >=1 string that exists as a technique title in field-guide.json. Prefer exact live titles (after rename pass). Family passes if intersection non-empty; leaf_exact reports full string match rate.
conformance_check.current_result: VERIFIED PASS (run 2026-07-12 against live const T, 324 techniques): all 17 named families subsume to >=1 existing entry; leaf exact-title match 104/104. Mousetrap removed (not catalogued; gap conf:low).
conformance_check.how_to_run: Load field-guide.json techniques[].title into a set; for each map[].subsumes.entries assert non-empty intersection and optionally 100% exact membership.
